fields.summary: Autonomous plan run with no owner. The orchestrator's message for this run diagnosed the loop: the conductor default's gate step runs `rhiza check` through sh in the run worktree, which resolves to the installed rhiza, so a branch that adds a CLI command, flag or setting fails the generated-reference comparison against docs/reference that the branch's own build passes, and the gate hands back to conduct again and again. Its hint: run rhiza check (with the docs/reference checks) with the PR head's build ($SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA), as ship open-pr's pre-push check already does, falling back to the installed rhiza only when no head build exists, with a testscript where a branch adds a documented CLI flag and the gate passes, all in one small change set. The planner read internal/run/engine.go (gate), internal/api/run.go (stepRunner), internal/api/check.go, internal/api/ship_build.go (runViaHead, used by land and render) and ship_prepush.go, and settled the design itself; each choice is recorded as an assumed Decision. Nothing is left open.
fields.title: Fix the gate step: autonomous plan run
